Weekly ADX is 12.4, suggesting a lack of trend. CCI at -193.4 and Stochastic %K at 12.3 are in extreme oversold territory. Approaching Fibonacci 0.618 retracement level at $91.85. Volume ratio at 0.28 shows contraction. 4-hour RSI is 37.9 and MACD histogram is -1.2742, signaling weakness. Unlike the overall market sentiment, this stock shows strong bearish signals. However, given the oversold RSI, proximity to the 0.618 Fibonacci support, and extreme readings on CCI and Stochastic, a short-term bounce is anticipated, warranting a buy entry.
